de: Panic of 1837: New York City banks suspend the payment of specie, triggering a national banking crisis and an economic depression whose severity was not surpassed until the Great Depression.

dz: 圣约瑟·穆蒂尼:由前奴隶贩子达加所领导的第1西印度团中的非洲士兵,在英国殖民地特立尼达发动了叛乱,企图逃到非洲.
de: St. Joseph Mutiny: African soldiers in the 1st West India Regiment – led by former slave trader Daaga – launch a rebellion in the British colony of Trinidad in an attempt to escape to Africa.

dz: 国王威廉四世去世,由侄女维多利亚接任.
de: King William IV dies, and is succeeded by his niece, Victoria.

dz: 威廉·库克和查尔斯·惠特斯通在伦敦成功展示了电讯图的首次商业用途.

de: Three African soldiers in the 1st West India Regiment – Daaga, Edward Coffin and Maurice Ogston – are executed for their role in the St. Joseph Mutiny in the British colony of Trinidad.

dz: Tiffany & Co. (最初被命名为Tiffany & Young)由查尔斯·刘易斯·蒂凡尼和泰迪·杨在纽约市创办. 该店被称作"花花公子和花花公子".
de: Tiffany & Co. (first named Tiffany & Young) is founded by Charles Lewis Tiffany and Teddy Young in New York City. The store is called a "stationery and fancy goods emporium".

de: In Alton, Illinois, abolitionist printer Elijah P. Lovejoy is shot dead by a mob while attempting to protect his printing shop from being destroyed a third time.
